an6.26:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā Mahākaccāno bhikkhū āmantesi:--
an6.26:1.3: Āvuso ti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato Mahākaccānassa paccassosuṃ.
an6.26:1.7: yāvañ c' idaṃ tena Bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya, yad idaṃ cha anussatiṭṭhānāni.
an6.26:2.3: ‘iti pi so Bhagavā . . . pe . . . Satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho Bhagavā' ti.
an6.26:2.4: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako Tathāgataṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:2.5: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.26:2.6: gedho ti kho āvuso pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.26:2.7: Sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena.
an6.26:2.8: Idam pi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. 4.
an6.26:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati
an6.26:3.2: ‘svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo . . . pe . . . paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī' ti.
an6.26:3.3: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako dhammaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:3.4: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.26:3.5: gedho ti kho āvuso pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.26:3.6: Sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena.
an6.26:3.7: Idam pi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. 5.
an6.26:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati
an6.26:4.2: ‘supaṭipanno Bhagavato sāvakasaṅgho . . . pe . . . anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā' ti.
an6.26:4.3: Yasmiṃ samaye ariyasāvako saṅghaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:4.4: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.26:4.5: gedho ti kho āvuso pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.26:4.6: Sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena.
an6.26:4.7: Idam pi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. 6.
an6.26:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso ariyasāvako attano sīlāni anussarati akhaṇḍāni . . . pe . . . samādhisaṃvattanikāni.
an6.26:5.2: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako sīlaṃ anussarati, nev' assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:5.3: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.26:5.4: gedho ti kho āvuso pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.26:5.5: Sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena.
an6.26:5.6: Idam pi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. 7.
an6.26:6.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso ariyasāvako attano cāgaṃ anussarati
an6.26:6.2: ‘lābhā vata me suladdhaṃ vata me . . . pe . . .
an6.26:6.4: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako cāgaṃ anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:6.5: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.26:6.6: gedho ti kho āvuso pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.26:6.7: Sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena.
an6.26:6.8: Idam pi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti. 8.
an6.26:7.1: Puna ca paraṃ āvuso ariyasāvako devatā anussarati
an6.26:7.2: ‘santi devā Cātummahārājika, santi devā . . . pe . . . Tatuttari;
an6.26:7.3: yathārūpāya saddhāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā saddhā saṃvijjati;
an6.26:7.7: paññāya samannāgatā tā devatā ito cutā tattha upapannā, mayham pi tathārūpā paññā saṃvijjati' ti.
an6.26:7.8: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye ariyasāvako attano ca tāsañ ca devatānaṃ saddhañ ca sīlañ ca sutañ ca cāgañ ca paññañ ca anussarati, nev'assa tasmiṃ samaye rāgapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na dosapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti, na mohapariyuṭṭhitaṃ cittaṃ hoti,
an6.26:7.9: ujugatam ev'assa tasmiṃ samaye cittaṃ hoti, nikkhantaṃ muttaṃ vuṭṭhitaṃ gedhamhā,
an6.26:7.10: gedho ti kho āvuso pañcann'etaṃ kāmaguṇānaṃ adhivacanaṃ.
an6.26:7.11: Sa kho so āvuso ariyasāvako sabbaso ākāsasamena cetasā viharati vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena.
an6.26:7.12: Idam pi kho āvuso ārammaṇaṃ karitvā evam idh' ekacce sattā visuddhidhammā bhavanti.
